timing: median of three warmed rounds; old/new order alternates; elapsed wall time with queue waits; not an overall model benchmark
notes: Tests cover continuous and tied scores, signed zero, NaN, infinities, denormals, identity selection, tails and live/capacity combinations.
Variants compare 256/512/1024 threads and serial/parallel integer digit search; floating score generation is unchanged.
Kernel resource queries report declared histogram bytes and runtime private/spill memory; histogram bytes are not total local allocation.
The 256-thread, nine-key parallel variant has zero reported spill bytes in this probe; its 33-key version reports 17216 spill bytes, so the proposed production path limits its live reach.
The archived kernel removes trailing whitespace; source_sha256 records the exact compiled input and archived_source_sha256 records the normalized copy.
